\section{Canonical equations}
\label{sec:equations}

\subsection{Peak-normalized analytic family}
\label{sec:analytic-family}

Let $J_1$ be the first-order Bessel function of the first kind.  Define the
collision-free peak-normalized function
\begin{equation}
  \mathcal{J}(x)=
  \begin{cases}
    2J_1(x)/x, & x\ne0,\\
    1, & x=0.
  \end{cases}
  \label{eq:peak-jinc}
\end{equation}
For $r'_a=r/s_a$ and $j_{1,1}=3.831706$, the generic SCI-JINC coefficient is
\begin{equation}
  \kappa_a(r'_a; a_a,b_a,c_a,(r_{\max})_a)
  =\mathcal{J}\!\left(\frac{2\pi r'_a}{a_a}\right)
   \exp\!\left[-\left(\frac{2r'_a}{b_a}\right)^{c_a}\right]
   \mathcal{J}\!\left(\frac{j_{1,1}r'_a}{(r_{\max})_a}\right).
  \label{eq:analytic-kernel}
\end{equation}
Equation~\eqref{eq:analytic-kernel} has $\kappa_a(0)=1$.
$a_a$ scales the first JINC argument, $b_a$ scales the generalized-exponential
envelope, $c_a$ is its exponent, and $(r_{\max})_a$ places the first zero of
the second JINC factor.  Analytic zeros and finite signed lobes are retained.
The square-cache rule, rather than a radial cutoff, determines membership.

\subsection{Signed estimator}
\label{sec:signed-estimator}

For the exact occurrence population of one bundle,
\begin{align}
  w_{ip} &= \omega_i\kappa_{ip},
    \label{eq:effective-coefficient}\\
  N_p &= \sum_i I_{ip}\omega_i\kappa_{ip}z_i,
    \label{eq:numerator}\\
  C_p &= \sum_i I_{ip}\omega_i\kappa_{ip},
    \label{eq:normalization}\\
  Q_p &= \sum_i I_{ip}\omega_i\kappa_{ip}^{2},
    \label{eq:quadratic}\\
  m_p &= \frac{N_p}{C_p},
    \label{eq:map-estimate}\\
  A_{pi} &= \frac{I_{ip}\omega_i\kappa_{ip}}{C_p}.
    \label{eq:operator}
\end{align}
All coupled accumulator terms for one contribution use the same $I_{ip}$ and
the same realized $\kappa_{ip}$ identity.  The normalization is signed.  A
finite negative $C_p$ is admissible; exact $C_p=0$ is not a zero-sky result.

\subsection{Conditioning and local support}
\label{sec:conditioning}

Define construction-state quantities
\begin{align}
  D_p &= \sum_i I_{ip}\left|\omega_i\kappa_{ip}\right|,
    \label{eq:absolute-sum}\\
  \rho_p &= \frac{|C_p|}{D_p}, \qquad D_p>0.
    \label{eq:cancellation-ratio}
\end{align}
For exact arithmetic, $0\le\rho_p\le1$.  Accepted local support requires
finite contributors, finite $N_p$, $C_p$, and $Q_p$, $Q_p>0$, $C_p\ne0$,
and a demonstration that total numerical error is negligible compared with
the approximately $10^{-3}$ relative fidelity relevant to the instrument.
Neither $D_p$ nor an error estimate is a persistent base-v0.1 product.

\subsection{Coefficient-squared time}
\label{sec:coefficient-time}

The sole authorized base-v0.1 time-support product is
\begin{equation}
  T_p^{(\kappa^2)}
  =\sum_i I_{ip}\frac{\kappa_{ip}^{2}}{f_{s,i}}.
  \label{eq:kappa-time}
\end{equation}
It is nonnegative and has unit seconds.  The squared object is $\kappa_{ip}$,
not $\omega_i$ or $w_{ip}$.

\subsection{Conditional mathematics retained for future science}
\label{sec:conditional-math}

The following identities do not create base-v0.1 products.  If and only if an
exact PTC family establishes $\omega_i=\operatorname{Var}(z_i)^{-1}$ for
mutually independent admitted occurrences,
\begin{align}
  \operatorname{Var}_{\mathrm{formal}}(m_p) &= \frac{Q_p}{C_p^2},
    \label{eq:conditional-variance}\\
  W_{\mathrm{formal},p} &= \frac{C_p^2}{Q_p},
    \label{eq:conditional-weight}\\
  \operatorname{Cov}(m_p,m_{p'})
   &=\frac{\sum_i I_{ip}I_{ip'}\omega_i\kappa_{ip}\kappa_{ip'}}
           {C_pC_{p'}}.
    \label{eq:conditional-covariance}
\end{align}
For a general available upstream covariance,
\begin{equation}
  \mathbf{C}_{\mathrm{JINC}}
  =\mathbf{A}_{\mathrm{JINC}}
   \mathbf{C}_{\mathrm{PTC}}
   \mathbf{A}_{\mathrm{JINC}}^{\mathsf T}.
  \label{eq:general-covariance}
\end{equation}
Inverse-square units alone do not establish inverse variance, independence,
precision, covariance authority, or significance.  Response, variance,
formal-weight, and covariance companions remain deferred until a concrete
scientific use separately authorizes them.
